title: Colonial legacies after independence
goal: I can explain what changed and what stayed the same in society after independence.
grammar: Imperfect and present perfect: what changed since the colony

items: I can explain what changed in the law and what has not disappeared since independence.
I can say what did not change at the same time, such as land and the vote.
I can describe how prejudices lasted after the legal castas ended.
I can say why independence still mattered.
I can use the imperfect and the present perfect to contrast the past with what has changed since.
